interaction_mode.description: Preferred: typed interaction mode. Legacy string `mode` still accepted via alias.

InteractionMode.description:
How this Session/Turn is allowed to act.

Orthogonal to [`crate::ExecutionKind`]: - ExecutionKind = who may talk / be invoked / be triggered - InteractionMode = what the loop may do this session

oneOf.description: Full tool surface (default). Maps to Cursor "Agent".
Only `update_plan` (+ read-only L0 helpers). No side-effect tools.
Must maintain goal + steps; delivery gated on plan completion.
Q&A / analysis text; tools denied or read-only surface.
Root-cause / failure attribution: diagnostics tools + ledger replay. (Renamed from Cursor-ish "Debug" — wire name is `diagnose`.)
